Six maki pieces (salmon, cucumber/avocado) come to about 220 kcal. A glass of cola, roughly 250 ml, adds about 105 kcal, and the wasabi is about 5 kcal. That puts the served total near 330 kcal.

Left over: a few crumbs, a little cola and most of the wasabi, about 10 kcal.

Eaten: about 320 kcal.

Sushi macros: protein about 8 g, carbohydrates about 38 g, fat about 4 g. The cola adds about 26 g of carbohydrates.
